answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2159 Country: MU Title: Is it permissible to invite the musallies on the 27th of Ramadan for a biryani on the masjid? Sometimes some people are individually requested to contribute for that. What is the hukm of that? An urgent reply is needed before they start announcing for that? Question: Is it permissible to invite the musallies on the 27th of Ramadan for a biryani on the masjid? Sometimes some people are individually requested to contribute for that. What is the hukm of that? An urgent reply is needed before they start announcing for that? Answer ID: 2159 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 669/664=M) The musallis can be invited to a feast any day in Ramazan, there is no proof to feed them biryani on 27 th date; so if they are invited without specifying any date then it is allowed, but it is not right to appeal for donation in this regard. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
